_doc: Table 3-11: Droid Personality Traits (Special Modifications printed 83): nine positive and nine negative traits by d100 band, and the two bands that are not traits (91-95, 96-100). Ruling release-r6-companions-c0 Q3 (R-R6CC-3). Text authored plain from the page (F-EDS-6).

traits.name: Loyal
traits.text: Puts its creator's needs above its own and looks for ways to help, asked or not.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.text: Adapts quickly to problems instead of getting stuck in narrow programming.

traits.name: Patient
traits.text: Has more patience than even the longest-lived organic beings.

traits.name: Enthusiastic
traits.text: Sees opportunities everywhere and points them out.

traits.name: Compassionate
traits.text: Cares for others and tries to bring out their best.

traits.name: Efficient
traits.text: Hates waste; does everything as quickly and precisely as it can.

traits.name: Well-Mannered
traits.text: Keeps perfect etiquette, even with people it dislikes.

traits.name: Cheerful
traits.text: Keeps a good attitude: the first step to success, it says.

traits.name: Reliable
traits.text: Always comes through for its creator and friends.

traits.name: Cowardly
traits.text: Puts its own survival first and shies away from danger.

traits.name: Overly Literal
traits.text: Takes words at their direct meaning and misses the nuance.

traits.name: Arrogant
traits.text: Thinks very highly of its own abilities.

traits.name: Impulsive
traits.text: Sees opportunities and acts on them without warning.

traits.name: Ruthless
traits.text: Destroys anything that gets in its way.

traits.name: Lazy
traits.text: Avoids doing the job it was built for whenever it can.

traits.name: Abrasive
traits.text: Sarcastic or silent; every word and act is barbed.

traits.name: Pessimistic
traits.text: Sees doom around every corner and says so.
